verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk or batch operation capability, such as bulk-updating employees or batch-creating records. What it does show is adjacent: aggregated read snapshots "in a single call" via the MCP server, per-item CLI commands whose JSON output can be piped through jq (a user-side scripting workaround), and an example natural-language prompt for generating an employee CSV, which is a hypothetical example rather than a documented bulk-operation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
